reason: The README describes a plugin whose primary purpose is analyzing and transcribing images through configurable external vision endpoints, with image attachment handling and local image archiving as supporting capabilities.

summaries.zh: 通过兼容 OpenAI 接口的视觉模型分析和转录图片，并支持处理图像附件及归档图片。
summaries.en: Analyzes and transcribes images through configurable OpenAI-compatible vision endpoints, with support for image attachments and local archiving.

capabilities: Sends local images or image URLs to a configured OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint
Reads local image files and fetches images from HTTP(S) URLs
Stores pasted images and manifests in a local image archive
Caches image transcriptions in a local file
Registers vision-enabled provider routes and agent tools
